reason: Kudzu naengmyeon in an ice-cold broth sounds like a really good lunch, and $18.95 for a bowl is normal for Honolulu. I'd go once, but only after I've looked at the Google and Yelp photos and reviews and they hold up.
objection: Nothing here tells me what other people think of it, so I have to go check the reviews myself. And $38.95 for kalbi plus tax and tip adds up fast if I bring friends, and the 20% added on for groups of 5 or more feels like a lot.
would_change_my_mind: If the Google or Yelp reviews come back mediocre or the photos look sad, I wouldn't go at all.
